adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in the code flow. Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the database update (prisma.booking.update at line 91) commits the new guests to the database first, then eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees is called (line 161), and finally sendAddGuestsEmails is called (line 165). If updateCalendarAttendees fails, the guests are already in the database but the calendar isn't updated. The email sending is wrapped in try-catch that only logs errors, so notification failures are silently ignored. If you retry with the same guests, they'll be filtered out by the uniqueGuests check (line 72-75) since they already exist in booking.attendees. This creates an inconsistent state with no recovery path.
